latest_message:
Dear Aida,

Thank you for your interest in the AI Assessment Report. I understand you're asking whether there's a cost involved.

The AI Assessment Report is an optional add-on that costs $2.00. Your video submission has already been received and shared with the hiring company at no charge. The assessment report is available to you if you'd like to purchase it for additional personal insight into how you're being evaluated — but it's completely optional, and the hiring company will make their decision based on your interview performance alone.

Let us know if you have any questions,

Best regards,

--
Jessica from Flowmingo Customer Support Team
